title: Vultures Help Eliminate Pathogens. Bird Flu Could Eliminate Them - Nautilus
gist: Vultures neutralize pathogens such as rabies, anthrax and botulism by consuming carrion in highly acidic stomachs, but 16 of 23 species are already threatened and H5N1 avian flu could devastate them. Biologists in Conservation Biology warn that vulture declines carry ecosystem and human-health consequences.

insights.claim: Vultures dispose of decaying animal matter, including bones, and neutralize pathogens such as rabies, anthrax, and botulism in their highly acidic stomachs.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Vultures provide a free sanitation and disease-control service whose loss could raise public-health and carcass-disposal costs.
